snippet: Program Kickoff. Initial tooling budget approved.
ID Team requests surface finish changes. Schedule impact minimal.
Tinderbox PCB thermal simulation shows hotspots. Respin likely.
Tooling T1 shots received. Texture depth inconsistent.
CRITICAL: Mold Cavity 4 collapsed during injection. Line Down.
Emergency tool repair underway. 3-week slip projected.
T2 shots verify repair. Sink marks on cosmetic surfaces.
Recovery plan approved. Expedite fees authorized.
PVT Build started. 5% yield fallout on Fader Caps.
Mass Production (MP) signed off. First units shipping.
Field Failure: Headphone Jack solder fracture reported in UK.
ECO-1049: Structural rib added to jack mount. Retooling.
